sections.heading: MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences fees 2025

content.text: When compare to other deemed universities, MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences offered various course in affordable fees. The yearly wise Allied health sciences fees in MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences is listed below:

sections.heading: Fees for Allied health sciences in MS Ramaiah University

items: The B.Sc Cardiac Care course has a fee of ₹2,70,000/- per year for the first three years, totaling ₹9,50,000/-.
The B.Sc Dialysis Therapy Technology course costs ₹1,65,000/- per year for three years, with a total fee of ₹7,00,000/-.
The B.Sc Medical Imaging Technology course is priced at ₹2,40,000/- per year for three years, amounting to ₹7,00,000/- in total.
The B.Sc Optometry course has a fee of ₹1,65,000/- per year for three years, totaling ₹3,30,000/-.
The B.Sc Operation Theatre Technology course charges ₹2,20,000/- per year for three years, with a total fee of ₹3,30,000/-.

content.text: Note: Other than college fees, students have to pay one time registration fees, semester exam fees, miscellaneous fees and hostel fee (if applicable)

sections.heading: MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences Reviews

content.text: Faculty

Students have rated the faculty at MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences highly for being knowledgeable, supportive, and practically focused. Most of the faculty members are postgraduates or hold doctoral degrees in their respective specialties. They emphasize skill-based teaching, clinical case discussions, and industry-relevant training to ensure students are job-ready.
Clinical Exposure and Placement

The university provides excellent clinical exposure through its own multispecialty hospital – MS Ramaiah Memorial Hospital – and other hospital tie-ups across Bangalore. From the second year, students undergo hands-on training in real-time hospital settings. The dedicated placement cell assists students with resume building, mock interviews, and securing placements in top hospitals and diagnostics labs.
Infrastructure

MSRUAS has a world-class campus equipped with advanced simulation labs, skill development centers, diagnostic training units, and smart classrooms. The on-campus hospital adds to the academic environment, while a well-stocked medical library and digital resources enhance the learning experience.
Campus Life

Campus life at MS Ramaiah University is vibrant and balanced. Students engage in medical expos, academic fests, cultural programs, and inter-college competitions. Separate hostels for boys and girls are provided with hygienic food, internet access, and 24/7 security for a safe and productive student life.
Affordability

MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences offers a great blend of quality education and affordable fee structure compared to other private health science universities in Karnataka. Scholarships and fee concessions are provided for meritorious and economically backward students.

sections.heading: MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences student reviews

content.text: Aishwarya S., B.Sc. Cardiac Care Technology (Batch of 2023) “T he academic structure at MSRUAS is very well organized. The faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, especially in the Allied Health Sciences department. I appreciated the focus on practical training—our hospital rotations gave us real-world experience from the second year itself. The campus is well-maintained, and facilities like the library, labs, and hostels are excellent. It’s a great place to build a strong foundation in healthcare. “

Ravi M., B.Sc. Cardiac Care Technology (Batch of 2022) “ Studying at MS Ramaiah University was a transformative experience. The curriculum is updated regularly to match industry standards, and the teaching approach is very interactive. What really stood out for me was the placement support—I secured a job through campus recruitment in my final year. The university also encourages innovation and research, which helped me in presenting papers at national-level conference.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: One of the key reasons students choose , is its affordable fee structure compared to other private paramedical colleges. The tuition fee in MS Ramaiah University offers great value for the quality of education, infrastructure, and hands-on clinical training provided. Moreover, the university supports deserving students with scholarships and financial aid, making professional healthcare education accessible to all. If you’re looking for a career in Allied Health Sciences with structured learning and strong job prospects, MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences is a choice worth investing in. For more details on direct admission, eligibility, or fees, feel free to connect with us for personalized guidance and admission support.

content.text: Yes, Graduates can work in hospitals, diagnostic labs, clinics, and healthcare centers in both the public and private sectors. They can take up roles such as medical technologists, imaging specialists, operation theatre technicians, dialysis technicians, and more.
